description: Sri Lanka Customs -  Rate of Exchange effective from 20.07.2020 to 26.07.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification (General) issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory matters governing customs operations.
